topic: التناقض في الأقوال — زاوية جديدة: Checklist عملية قبل بدء أي إجراء
prompt: A single, medium‑shot interior scene set in a modern, modest office‑style interview room. A plain drywall wall behind a small window lets in soft, diffused daylight that falls evenly across the room. At the center, a rectangular wooden table is covered with three items: an open, official‑looking police report form (its pages filled with generic lines and check‑boxes), a second sheet resembling a later written statement (hand‑written style lines), and a closed notebook opened to a page of neatly penciled dates and brief notes. A red ball‑point pen lies across the notebook, its tip touching a line where the writer has just made a small correction. Seated on the left side of the table is a civilian—gender‑neutral, mid‑30s, wearing a plain shirt and jeans—leaning slightly forward, eyes focused on the two documents. Their right hand holds the pen, poised to underline a discrepancy between the two papers; their left hand rests on the notebook, fingers lightly tapping the page as if checking the chronological order they recorded earlier. Directly opposite, a police officer in contemporary uniform (dark shirt, badge‑style insignia visible but not detailed) sits upright, a neutral expression, one hand resting on the police report form, the other holding a small tablet that displays a simple timeline graphic (no readable text). The officer’s posture suggests they are listening while reviewing the paperwork. In the background, a modest wall clock with clean, round face shows the time around early afternoon, reinforcing the sense of an official yet everyday setting. The composition is balanced: the civilian’s perspective is slightly angled toward the camera, giving a clear view of the contrasting documents, while the officer’s side remains just out of focus, emphasizing the tension over the inconsistency. The lighting is even, with no harsh shadows, highlighting the papers, pen, and the attentive expressions of both participants.
